title: Pork Kimchi Stew
summary: A classic kimchi stew made with pork and well-fermented kimchi.

steps.description: Cut the kimchi into bite-size pieces and prepare the pork, tofu, and green onion.
Cook the pork in a pot over medium heat until the outside is no longer pink.
Add the kimchi and stir-fry for another 2 to 3 minutes, then pour in the water.
Add the gochugaru, soup soy sauce, and minced garlic. Simmer over medium-low heat for about 15 minutes.
Add the tofu and green onion, simmer for another 3 to 5 minutes, and adjust the seasoning to taste.
